From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medsyn.com>, Tom O'Brien <tom.obrien@medsyn.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: MedSyn SDK + Streaming integration — owners & build asks

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call this morning. Attached is a first-pass MAP focused on the integration build milestone (attached as MedSyn_MAP_v1.2.pdf). This message is a concise recap and an ask to confirm owners and the target close date so we can trigger procurement & staging.

Recap (integration build milestone):
- Scope: SDK integration (language wrappers), streaming-enabled inference with tool calling, structured-output schemas for results, CI/UAT harness.
- Proposed target close: 2026-04-30 (target close for MVP integration).

Proposed milestone owners (please confirm):
- SDK wrapper & docs: Dev Patel (Redwood)
- Streaming + tool calling examples: Rafael Mendes (Redwood)
- Structured outputs & schema sign-off: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) 
- Customer-side integration & test data: Asha + MedSyn engineering
- UAT coordination & procurement gating: Marissa Cole (Redwood)

Dependencies we flagged on the call:
- Staging API keys + test dataset (MedSyn)
- Procurement SOW signed (MedSyn procurement)
- VPN / network allowlist for staging (if on-prem endpoints are used)
- SOC2 / security questionnaire evidence (Redwood to share)

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm owners above by EOD Friday (2026-04-05).
2) Confirm whether MedSyn can provide test dataset by 2026-04-09.
3) We propose a technical kickoff: Tue 07 Apr 2026, 10:00 PT — Rafael + Dev will lead the technical sections. Please confirm attendee list.

Attachments: MedSyn_MAP_v1.2.pdf (MAP draft) — includes milestones, acceptance criteria, and a proposed rollout calendar.

If anything above needs to move (target close or owners), call it out and we’ll adjust. Happy to take this to the SOW/procurement thread once MedSyn confirms scope.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Connor —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP PDF. We reviewed quickly this morning and overall the scope looks good. A few clarifications from our side before we lock owners: 

- Streaming + tool-calling: we need a short example that shows a streaming session invoking a retrieval tool and returning a JSON schema for downstream processing. Can Rafael include that in the kickoff pack?
- Pinned model / latency targets: we need an estimate of latency at 2k tokens and any recommended quantization profile you expect us to use in staging.
- Procurement: procurement@medsyn.com will own the SOW loop — tagging them here. Our legal lead will want to see the SOC2 extract and the data-retention controls; can Redwood provide a short pointer or excerpt?

We should be able to confirm owners by EOD Monday. We can provide a small synthetic test dataset by 2026-04-09 if you can confirm expected format (JSONL or parquet).

Asha Patel
Head of Integrations, MedSyn Health
asha.patel@medsyn.com | +1 212-555-0876

Hi Asha — thanks for the callouts, good items. Quick responses and a small update to the MAP: we attached an integration-scope spreadsheet (integration-scope_v3.xlsx) with a short work estimate per milestone.

Quick answers:
- Rafael will include a streaming+tool-calling *example* in the kickoff pack (a simple retrieval->tool->structured-output flow).
- Latency estimate: for the 2k token window using the recommended q4 quantization profile on our dedicated host we expect p95 generation latency ~180-240ms per token under our staging load — Rafael will run a quick benchmark in the first week of the kickoff and report back.
- SOC2: Connor to share Redwood SOC2 excerpt during kickoff (we have a short extract we can provide).
- Test data format: JSONL preferred; parquet is fine if that’s easier.

Updated milestone calendar (high level):
- 2026-04-07: Technical kickoff (10:00 PT) — Rafael + Dev lead.
- 2026-04-09: MedSyn delivers test dataset (customer).
- 2026-04-12: SDK wrapper baseline complete (Dev).
- 2026-04-19: Streaming + tool-calling examples integrated (Rafael).
- 2026-04-23: Structured-output schema signoff (Neha + Asha).
- 2026-04-30: MVP integration complete & UAT start (all) — target close.

We’ve added the SOW/procurement milestone: MedSyn SOW signed by 2026-04-16 to keep the target close realistic. Please review integration-scope_v3.xlsx and flag any high-effort rows.

Attachments: integration-scope_v3.xlsx (work estimates + task breakdown)

Connor

--
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 05 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: MedSyn SDK + Streaming integration — owners & build asks

Hi all —

Adding a few technical clarifications and owners for the integration work so expectations are explicit. I also attached a small credentials stub (redwood-sdks-credentials.txt) we’ll use for staging access (placeholder — Connor will provision actual creds).

Technical notes & task owners (more granular):
1) SDK wrapper (Dev Patel)
   - Language targets: Python + Node first; Java/Go later (stretch).
   - Deliverables: quickstart, code examples for generation + streaming, unit tests.

2) Streaming + tool-calling (Rafael Mendes)
   - Deliverables: streaming sample that demonstrates incremental tokens + a tool invocation pattern (retriever call) returning a JSON schema.
   - Benchmarks: p50/p95 token latency, memory footprint for 2k token context.

3) Structured outputs & acceptance schema (Neha Kapoor)
   - Deliverables: canonical JSON Schema (v1) and sample mapping for MedSyn fields.

4) CI/UAT & test harness (Dev + Rafael)
   - Deliverables: automated harness to run sample prompts and assert schema conformance; nightly smoke tests against staging.

Gating items:
- Procurement SOW (MedSyn) — staging GPU/host access only after SOW if required by contract.
- Test data format & sample records (Asha) — need a few representative records by 2026-04-09.
- Network allowlist & any on-prem firewall rules (Tom) — share IPs and port ranges.

Small code example (pseudo):
> // streaming -> tool call -> structured JSON> stream.on('token', t => emit(t));
> const doc = retriever.retrieve(query);
> const result = tool.call('lookupPatient', {patientId: doc.id});
> respond({status: 'ok', patient: result});

I’ll own the streaming benchmarks and work with Dev on the SDK quickstart. Connor — I’ll need the staging creds to run an early perf sweep; can you provision before Tue?

-Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

Connor / team —

Thanks — this is helpful. We can commit to the timeline provided we hit two gating items on our side: 1) procurement signs the SOW by 2026-04-16, and 2) we provide the test dataset by 2026-04-09 (Asha will confirm format). I’d also like to add a privacy review milestone before UAT signoff — our privacy officer needs to confirm that structured outputs contain only allowed PHI fields and retention aligns with our policies.

Action items from MedSyn:
- Procurement will review SOW; procurement@medsyn.com is on the thread.
- We’ll confirm test dataset format by EOD Monday.
- Privacy review: add milestone "Privacy sign-off" targeted 2026-04-25.

Connor — please add the privacy milestone to the MAP and share the SOC2 extract ahead of the kickoff so our legal can review. Rafael — we’ll attend the 07 Apr kickoff; please include the streaming example in the pack.

Tom O'Brien
